name: Fairshake
summary: The crypto industry's super PAC, with two affiliates that spend in Republican (Defend American Jobs) and Democratic (Protect Progress) primaries. Funded mainly by Coinbase, Ripple and Andreessen Horowitz, it raised $260 million from March 2023 to December 2024 and spent more than $133 million on 2024 races, nearly twice as much on Republicans as on Democrats. It raised more than $193 million for 2026 by January 2026, and its biggest 2026 bets favored Republicans.

sources.title: Crypto PACs spent $170 million, with most going to Republicans in final weeks — CoinDesk

finances.description: Raised from March 2023 to December 2024; spending is with its affiliates, on 2024 races.

connections.name: Kari Lake
connections.description: Fairshake's Democratic affiliate, Protect Progress, spent about $10 million backing Ruben Gallego, who beat Lake in Arizona's 2024 Senate race. No crypto PAC spent against Lake directly, and the industry's Stand With Crypto rated her A.
